name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE Raptorclaw Mk4 Combat Arm
product_name: Arcturus Defense Solutions Raptorclaw Mark 4 Combat Arm
description:
The Raptorclaw Mk4 is a full-arm combat replacement built on a titanium-carbide endoskeleton with integrated forearm blade housing capable of deploying a 28cm monofilament-edged ceramic blade in under 0.2 seconds. Recoil-dampening hydraulic buffers run the length of the humerus analog, allowing the arm to absorb and redirect kinetic force from heavy firearms without destabilizing the shooter. Striking surfaces on the knuckle plating are reinforced with tungsten composite capable of punching through light vehicle panels.

Primarily issued to GLMC special operations and licensed to Tier 3-4 private security contractors operating in the Shelf's contested industrial zones. On the street, decommissioned units show up stripped of their restricted firmware governors, making them popular with gang enforcers who call them 'Raptors' and use them to settle territorial disputes with horrifying efficiency.
installation_requirements: Full shoulder disarticulation, military-grade neural bridge socket, licensed surgical facility, background clearance
rejection_risk: Moderate – titanium-carbide frame limits biocompatibility adaptation; neural bridge socket requires 6-week calibration
maintenance: Bi-monthly hydraulic fluid replacement, blade edge servicing, firmware security patch uploads

cultural_context: The Raptorclaw has become something of a grim status symbol in the Shelf's gang hierarchy — having a decommissioned Mk4 means you either killed someone who had one or you used to be something official. GLMC brass has launched three separate black-market crackdowns in the past decade, none of which have meaningfully reduced supply.

story_hooks: A stolen shipment of ungoverned Raptorclaw Mk4s has flooded a Shelf district, and someone is paying very well to find out who pulled the heist
A player's contact turns up dead — killed by a blade pattern that matches Raptorclaw deployment, but the registered owner has a bulletproof alibi
